nodes.label: .`a reset from chapter 3 pays 3 crystals and puts the campaign back at its start`()
.`a reset deletes every talent level and every talent point award`()
.`a reset keeps the auto click level`()
.`a first reset of a player with no crystals pays the reward and counts 1`()
.`a reset from chapter 1 is locked and changes nothing`()
.`a reset from another chapter is a mismatch carrying the stored progress and changes nothing`()
.`a repeated reset is a mismatch and pays once`()
.`a reset for an unknown user fails`()
.`an applied reset logs the username, the chapter, the reward, the crystals and the resets at info`()
